name: HYDRA-UMC-DSI
build: flutter pub get && flutter build apk.
notes: Native touch UI for the onboard 7" DSI touchscreen, same client role as the mobile apps but embedded on the CM5 itself. v0.1.5: a failed secure-storage delete during logout, or a partial saveToken() write (token saved, username save failed), could leave a real, orphaned token that a later loadToken() would resurrect - fixed with a plain, non-secret hydra_logged_out marker checked before secure storage is ever consulted, plus a best-effort revert of a partial write. Same fix ported to HYDRA-UMC-IOS-CONTROL.
